subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

229, 233, 239, 241, 251, ?
solution:
The logic here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79f2c5a11aa5669ba06217fa0b073b28edd0dbb41f96d24257ffe452211e5b27.png] 

As we can see that all the given numbers are prime numbers.

Prime numbers are numbers which have only two factors i.e. 1 and the number itself. 

So, the next prime number after 251 will be 257.

Hence, the correct answer will be __**257**__.
